_doc: IDWriteFontFace (most-derived IDWriteFontFace7). The hand subclass IDWriteFontFace.ts keeps the per-glyph array helpers and the fontAxisValues accessor. Skips below are methods the generic emitter mis-lowers: each takes a glyph-index input array of length glyphCount and writes a PARALLEL OUTPUT array of the same length, but the emitter treats the output pointer as a single out element (returning only the first). They need the parallel-output-array pattern (same root cause as the IDWriteTextAnalyzer shaping methods) or a hand wrapper.

IDWriteFontFace.GetGlyphIndices._why: out UINT16* glyphIndices is an array of glyphCount; hand getGlyphIndices returns number[]

IDWriteFontFace.GetDesignGlyphMetrics._why: out DWRITE_GLYPH_METRICS* is an array of glyphCount; hand getDesignGlyphMetrics returns DWRITE_GLYPH_METRICS[]

IDWriteFontFace.GetDesignGlyphAdvances._why: out INT32* glyphAdvances is an array of glyphCount, mis-lowered to a single number

IDWriteFontFace.GetGdiCompatibleGlyphAdv._why: out INT32* glyphAdvances is an array of glyphCount, mis-lowered to a single number

IDWriteFontFace.GetGdiCompatibleGlyphMet._why: out DWRITE_GLYPH_METRICS* is an array of glyphCount, mis-lowered to a single struct

IDWriteFontFace.GetKerningPairAdjustment._why: out INT32* glyphAdvanceAdjustments is an array of glyphCount, mis-lowered to a single number

IDWriteFontFace.GetPaletteEntries._why: hand getPaletteEntries(paletteIndex, first, count) returns DWRITE_COLOR_F[] (core/color.ts); the generated one mis-lowers the entryCount array to a single scalar

IDWriteFontFace.GetPanose._why: hand getPanose() returns the raw 10-byte Uint8Array; DWRITE_PANOSE has an unnamed nested union the struct emitter skips

IDWriteFontFace.GetGlyphImageData._why: hand getGlyphImageData(glyphId, ppem, format) reads the struct (core/color.ts), copies the bytes, and calls ReleaseGlyphImageData; the void** context + nested D2D types can't be lowered

IDWriteFontFace.GetVerticalGlyphVariants._why: out UINT16* verticalGlyphIndices is an array of glyphCount, mis-lowered to a single number

IDWriteFontFace.GetGlyphRunOutline._why: leading FLOAT emSize + parallel glyphIndices/glyphAdvances/glyphOffsets arrays sharing one glyphCount; the emitter drops emSize and sources the count from the offsets array. Hand getGlyphRunOutline(emSize, glyphIndices, sink, opts) passes the slot args in the correct order.
